integrity: Full proof uses direct integral and exact finite-path spectrum; finite verification scripts are supplementary and do not constitute an infinite certificate.
scientific_limitations: Fixed half-translation and one unit-height Haar window; no claim for other translations, windows, nonuniform lattices, or noise stability. Closest historic frame-bound literature may contain an unindexed equivalent formulation.
title: A cosine staircase of sharp Haar Gabor frame bounds
